title: Logo & Icon
slide_intent: Orient the reader at the transition from language to marks. The chapter break makes the shift in subject visible before the logo rules begin.
strategic_value: The repeated divider gives the identity book a consistent cadence as its subject changes.
demonstration: Logo & Icon replaces the previous chapter title in the same white-on-dark divider layout.
practical_value: Use this arrangement to separate the introduction of the mark from the denser pages about its handling.

content_islands.name: Book identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place a small white Bolt mark in the upper-left corner and the folio in the lower-left corner.

content_islands.name: Section title
content_islands.spec: Set “Logo & Icon” in large white type on the dark full-page field. Align the title near mid-height, inset farther than the small identifiers.
